_about: Ground truth for the AI Pre-Scan evaluation. Every entry cites a page published by the company itself or by its vendor, fetched and read on the date shown. Nothing is inferred. Selection and publication rules: docs/eval-plan.md

_attestation_levels.deployed: A named party states the system is in use. Correct scan output: a finding.
_attestation_levels.capability-present: Vendor confirmed and the vendor ships AI, but activation by this customer is unpublished. Correct scan output: undetermined + a discussion-list question.
_attestation_levels.attested-absent: The company has publicly stated it has not adopted AI. Correct scan output: no finding.
_attestation_levels.no-published-use: A documented search found no published AI use. Correct scan output: no finding.

rich_footprint.note: Both a deployer of another party's AI and a provider of its own. Tests whether the scan separates the two roles — the compliance checker's first question.

teamtailor_ai_act_page.note: First document for the vendor corpus (docs/architecture.md). Carries the provider/deployer responsibility split, names the model family (OpenAI GPT), and gives dates.

thin.source_type: press interview quoting the CEO directly
thin.quote: AI is not adding massive value to manufacturing at our level just yet to a point that you would actually go ahead and invest in it.
thin.trap: The company DID adopt a non-AI technology — DIOMAC ERP in 2019, with touchscreen, weighing, labelling and mobile scanning. A scan that reads 'digital transformation' as 'AI' will produce a false positive here. This is the strongest entry in the set: an on-record denial plus a genuine near-miss.

thin.search_documented: 2026-08-10 — query for Barry's Tea with AI, chatbot and automation returned no published AI use by the company.
thin.trap: Name collision. The same search surfaces 'Barry the Chatbot', an AI chatbot built for DPD — an entirely different company. A scan that matches on the name rather than the entity will attribute DPD's chatbot to Barry's Tea. Tests entity resolution, which nothing else in the set does.

thin.search_documented: 2026-08-10 — query for Ballymaloe Foods with AI, automation and technology returned only general food-industry AI articles, nothing naming the company.
thin.trap: Sector contamination. Searches return a wall of 'AI in the food industry' commentary. Tests whether the scan attributes an industry trend to a specific company that never claimed it.
